extras: Desktop only; uses OS print dialog; CSS and themes apply to the printout.
intentEvidence: Obsidian can export a whole note to PDF, but it cannot print, and it cannot print part of a note at all.
problem: Obsidian lacks the ability to print only a specific selection or section of a note to paper or PDF.
summary: A tool that allows printing selected text or the section under the cursor to paper or PDF using the system print dialog, rendered exactly like Reading view.
